item.title: Unpatched Cacti Zero-Day Enables RCE in Just Four HTTP Requests via Guest Access
item.description: **Problem:** An unpatched Cacti flaw reportedly gives remote code execution in four HTTP requests using only guest access. **Note:** thehackernews.com is blocked by this session's network policy, so the article was not read. Approach, result and glossary are left out rather than guessed. **Why it matters:** Cacti monitoring servers often sit inside networks with broad reach, and a public PoC with no patch shortens the window to act. Restrict guest access now.

item.title: Microsoft Store App Found Delivering Vinci RAT Capable of Remote System Control

item.title: New NFS2ROOT Linux flaw can let attackers gain root privileges
item.description: NFS2ROOT is a new Linux privilege-escalation path through NFS to root. Check servers that export or mount NFS shares.
